001package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog;
002
003import org.apache.commons.lang3.Validate;
004import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.annotations.HistoryLogProps;
005import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.helpers.Bytes;
006import java.util.Set;
007import java.util.TreeSet;
008
009/**
010 * Basal-IQ (predictive low glucose suspend) periodic record.
011 */
012@HistoryLogProps(
013    opCode = 140,
014    displayName = "PLGS Periodic",
015    internalName = "LID_PLGS_PERIODIC"
016)
017public class PlgsPeriodicHistoryLog extends HistoryLog {
018
019    private long timestamp;
020    private int fmr;
021    private int pgv;
022    private int fmrStatus;
023    private boolean pgvValid;
024    private int ruleState;
025    private int hoMinState;
026    private long status;
027
028    public PlgsPeriodicHistoryLog() {}
029    public PlgsPeriodicHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum) {
030        this(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, 0, 0, 0, 0, false, 0, 0, 0);
031    }
032
033    public PlgsPeriodicHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, long timestamp, int fmr, int pgv, int fmrStatus, boolean pgvValid, int ruleState, int hoMinState, long status) {
034        super(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum);
035        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, timestamp, fmr, pgv, fmrStatus, pgvValid, ruleState, hoMinState, status);
036        parse(cargo);
037    }
038
039    public PlgsPeriodicHistoryLog(long timestamp, int fmr, int pgv, int fmrStatus, boolean pgvValid, int ruleState, int hoMinState, long status) {
040        this(0, 0, timestamp, fmr, pgv, fmrStatus, pgvValid, ruleState, hoMinState, status);
041    }
042
043    public int typeId() {
044        return 140;
045    }
046
047    /**
048     * <table border="1">
049     * <caption>Parsed fields for PlgsPeriodicHistoryLog:</caption>
050     * <tr><td><code>timestamp</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readUint32(raw, 10)</code></td></tr>
051     * <tr><td><code>fmr</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 14)</code></td></tr>
052     * <tr><td><code>pgv</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 16)</code></td></tr>
053     * <tr><td><code>fmrStatus</code></td><td><code>raw[18] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
054     * <tr><td><code>pgvValid</code></td><td><code>raw[19] != 0</code></td></tr>
055     * <tr><td><code>ruleState</code></td><td><code>raw[20] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
056     * <tr><td><code>hoMinState</code></td><td><code>raw[21] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
057     * <tr><td><code>status</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readUint32(raw, 22)</code></td></tr>
058     * </table>
059     */
060    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
061        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
062        this.cargo = raw;
063        parseBase(raw);
064        this.timestamp = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 10);
065        this.fmr = Bytes.readShort(raw, 14);
066        this.pgv = Bytes.readShort(raw, 16);
067        this.fmrStatus = raw[18] & 0xFF;
068        this.pgvValid = raw[19] != 0;
069        this.ruleState = raw[20] & 0xFF;
070        this.hoMinState = raw[21] & 0xFF;
071        this.status = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 22);
072    }
073
074    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum) {
075        return buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, 0, 0, 0, 0, false, 0, 0, 0);
076    }
077
078    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, long timestamp, int fmr, int pgv, int fmrStatus, boolean pgvValid, int ruleState, int hoMinState, long status) {
079        return HistoryLog.fillCargo(Bytes.combine(
080            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(140, 0),
081            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
082            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
083            Bytes.toUint32(timestamp),
084            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(fmr),
085            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(pgv),
086            new byte[]{(byte) fmrStatus},
087            new byte[]{(byte) (pgvValid ? 1 : 0)},
088            new byte[]{(byte) ruleState},
089            new byte[]{(byte) hoMinState},
090            Bytes.toUint32(status)));
091    }
092
093    /**
094     * @return timestamp, in seconds
095     */
096    public long getTimestamp() {
097        return timestamp;
098    }
099    /**
100     * @return five minute reading, in mg/dL
101     */
102    public int getFmr() {
103        return fmr;
104    }
105    /**
106     * @return predicted glucose value, in mg/dL
107     */
108    public int getPgv() {
109        return pgv;
110    }
111    /**
112     * @return raw FMR status, see {@link FmrStatus}
113     */
114    public int getFmrStatus() {
115        return fmrStatus;
116    }
117    public FmrStatus getFmrStatusEnum() {
118        return FmrStatus.fromId(fmrStatus);
119    }
120    /**
121     * @return whether the predicted glucose value is valid
122     */
123    public boolean isPgvValid() {
124        return pgvValid;
125    }
126    /**
127     * @return raw rule state bitmask, see {@link RuleState}
128     */
129    public int getRuleState() {
130        return ruleState;
131    }
132    public Set<RuleState> getRuleStateSet() {
133        return RuleState.fromId(ruleState);
134    }
135    /**
136     * @return raw hypo minimizer state, see {@link HoMinState}
137     */
138    public int getHoMinState() {
139        return hoMinState;
140    }
141    public HoMinState getHoMinStateEnum() {
142        return HoMinState.fromId(hoMinState);
143    }
144    /**
145     * @return raw status bitmask, see {@link Status}
146     */
147    public long getStatus() {
148        return status;
149    }
150    public Set<Status> getStatusSet() {
151        return Status.fromId(status);
152    }
153
154    public enum FmrStatus {
155        NO_FMR(0),
156        PERIODIC_GLUCOSE_READING(1),
157        CALIBRATION_RESPONSE_GLUCOSE_READING(2),
158        SENSOR_SESSION_STOPPED(3),
159        SENSOR_SESSION_STARTED(4),
160        CALIBRATION_ENTERED(5),
161        PUMPING_EVENT(6)
162
163        ;
164        private final int id;
165        FmrStatus(int id) {
166            this.id = id;
167        }
168
169        public static FmrStatus fromId(int id) {
170            for (FmrStatus r : values()) {
171                if (r.id == id) {
172                    return r;
173                }
174            }
175            return null;
176        }
177
178        public int getId() {
179            return id;
180        }
181    }
182
183    public enum RuleState {
184        HO_SUSPEND_RULE(1),
185        HO_RECOVERY_RULE(2),
186        HO_UNAVAILABLE_RULE(4)
187
188        ;
189        private final int id;
190        RuleState(int id) {
191            this.id = id;
192        }
193
194        public static Set<RuleState> fromId(int mask) {
195            Set<RuleState> items = new TreeSet<>();
196            for (RuleState i : values()) {
197                if ((mask & i.getId()) != 0) {
198                    items.add(i);
199                }
200            }
201            return items;
202        }
203
204        public int getId() {
205            return id;
206        }
207    }
208
209    public enum HoMinState {
210        ON_AND_AVAILABLE(0),
211        ON_AND_SUSPENDED(1),
212        OFF(2),
213        ON_AND_NOT_AVAILABLE(3)
214
215        ;
216        private final int id;
217        HoMinState(int id) {
218            this.id = id;
219        }
220
221        public static HoMinState fromId(int id) {
222            for (HoMinState r : values()) {
223                if (r.id == id) {
224                    return r;
225                }
226            }
227            return null;
228        }
229
230        public int getId() {
231            return id;
232        }
233    }
234
235    public enum Status {
236        SUSPEND_PREDICTED(1),
237        SUSPEND_CURRENT(2),
238        RESUME_EGV_RISE(16),
239        RESUME_NADIR_LOCK(64),
240        UNAVAILABLE_TIME_SMALL(128),
241        UNAVAILABLE_SUSPEND_OVERRIDE(256),
242        UNAVAILABLE_CGM_OFF(512),
243        UNAVAILABLE_HIGH_EGV(1024),
244        UNAVAILABLE_NOT_THERAPY(2048),
245        UNAVAILABLE_BOLUS_ACTIVE(4096),
246        UNAVAILABLE_NO_CURRENT(8192)
247
248        ;
249        private final int id;
250        Status(int id) {
251            this.id = id;
252        }
253
254        public static Set<Status> fromId(long mask) {
255            Set<Status> items = new TreeSet<>();
256            for (Status i : values()) {
257                if ((mask & i.getId()) != 0) {
258                    items.add(i);
259                }
260            }
261            return items;
262        }
263
264        public int getId() {
265            return id;
266        }
267    }
268}
